findings.title: R2-04: Local cancellation normal form and noncrossing ancestry for Rule 30
findings.claim: Every output disagreement admits a factorization preserving its leftmost differing parent with even remaining contributions. For any two Rule 30 histories, every surviving disagreement has an initial disagreement ancestor and root labels are spatially nondecreasing at every finite time; this is specialized to the official single-seed histories.
findings.scope: All six Boolean local inputs; arbitrary Rule 30 histories on the integer line, all natural times. The official seed specialization allows all T,P,t. Literal path involutions are finite-tested only: T=0..3, P=1..4, through time 10.
findings.result: Unchanged official checker passed all 44 custom declarations and 12 headlines. Exact finite involutions preserved zero/one residuals, including even path families through zero-disagreement vertices. No center survivor is asserted.

findings.title: R2-04: The least-source frontier retreats; monotone progress is false
findings.claim: The candidate strengthening R_(t+1)>=R_t for the rightmost descendant of the least initial disagreement is false, already for canonical Rule30 T=P=1 at t=1 to t=2.
findings.scope: Finite physical/packed witness: root descendants {-3,-1} at t=1 become {-4,-2} at t=2. A separate open sufficient conjecture asks for some center reach for every T>=0,P>=1.
findings.result: The witness agrees under physical truth-table evolution, selected-parent propagation, and packed masks. The weaker center-reach conjecture survived 4096 rectangular plus 32 held-out comparisons through 4*(T+P)+128, but has no unbounded proof.

findings.title: R2-03: bounded rank cannot satisfy the original three-observation descent guard
findings.claim: The proposed replacement score R(T,P) in 0..B, strictly decreasing under two steps whenever three canonical center observations agree, cannot exist universally.
findings.scope: Every uniformly bounded natural score on canonical pairs, including ranks of all fixed-dimensional matrices over any field. Not the unbounded integer off-diagonal score from round one.
findings.result: A written pigeonhole proof forces B+1 strict drops; exact single-seed witnesses cover B=1,2,3. At B=2, T=1,P=25 gives the repeated block 1011100.

findings.title: R2-03: nonlinear source parities at separated binary scales
findings.claim: The dyadic difference matrix M(T,n,K)[i,j]=c(T+i+2^(K+j))+c(T+i), with 2^K>T+n-1 over GF(2), has an exact nonlinear source representation. Unbounded rank for T=0 would imply official Problem 1.
findings.scope: Actual Rule 30 single-seed center, with explicit finite-support and binary-kernel conditions. Proposed sufficient growth lemma U is open.
findings.result: Known Duhamel decomposition specialized to separated binary scales; 760 exact block checks and 32,780 crosschecked bits. Tested square-family ranks through size 12 are 0,1,1,3,5,6,6,7,8,10,10,11. Eventual period P after T0 bounds every such rank by T0+P.

findings.title: R2-03: time-monotone rank and a near-full-rank shortcut fail
findings.claim: Two proposed strengthenings fail: nondecreasing rank as T advances, and rank M(0,n,ceil(log2 n)) >= n-1 for every n>=2.
findings.scope: Actual single-seed center with the admissible separation condition. These failures concern only the two strengthenings, not the open growth lemma.
findings.result: At n=2,K=8, T=0 to T=1 drops rank 1 to 0. At n=3,K=2, rows 000,001,000 have rank 1, below n-1=2.

findings.title: Left-edge agreement depth depends only on v2(p) and is constant in t for v2(p)<=3: the constants are 8, 29, 400
findings.claim: In the moving integer frame from the single-cell seed, depth(t,p), the number of leading left-edge cells on which row t and row t-p agree, was identical for every tested p of the same 2-adic valuation and identical for every t in [3000,6000): 8 at v2=1, 29 at v2=2, 400 at v2=3. At v2(p)>=4 it is not constant in t. The 29-cell period-4 prefix independently corroborates the 26-cell common ether prefix assumed by the kernel-checked absorbing-prefix barrier, so that barrier hypothesis is generic on this orbit rather than a corner case.
findings.scope: Single black cell seed; Phi(a)=a XOR ((a<<1)|(a<<2)); rows high-bit aligned; T=6000; every t in [3000,6000); p in {2,6,10,14,4,12,20,28,36,44,8,24,40,56,72,16,48,80,32,96}. Pure enumeration.
findings.result: Ran. Constants reproduce exactly across all tested p within each valuation class and all t in range.

verification.limits: T=6000 rows; t restricted to [3000,6000); 20 periods; single seed; Python ints, no solver, no timeout reached; runtime under 5 minutes on one core.

findings.title: Sharp transition at v2(p)=4: the regular region goes from a bounded strip to a constant fraction (about 0.375) of the light cone
findings.claim: For v2(p)<=3 the agreement depth is a constant and its share of the cone (2t+1) tends to zero. For v2(p)>=4 the depth grows linearly in t, holding a fraction near 0.375 across t=1000 to t=7999, an eightfold range. At p=16 the fraction read 0.385, 0.377, 0.381, 0.378, 0.376. Therefore roughly three eighths of every row lies in a period-16 regular region that begins beyond the 29-cell strip, entirely outside what a prefix reader absorbing on the ether prefix can observe.
findings.result: Ran. Fraction stable near 0.375 for v2>=4; p=8 control pinned at exactly 400 at t=1000, 4000 and 7999.

verification.limits: T=8000 rows; five t values; six periods; no solver; runtime under 5 minutes on one core.

findings.title: Proposed well-founded resource: Dershowitz-Manna multiset over non-regular blocks, with the period-16 regular region as the identity element
findings.claim: Proposal, not run. Take the F002 period-16 regular region as the identity, decompose the complement into maximal non-regular blocks, and order the finite multiset of blocks by Dershowitz-Manna under a per-block ordinal. This is not of the barred form: a DM multiset order is not a signed integer prefix energy with geometric per-letter costs, and the regular region is an identity element rather than an absorbing reader state. Ether insertion and long vacuum segments are rank-invariant by construction, and block mergers are safe because DM permits removing an element. MISSING LEMMA, stated exactly: for every Rule 30 step in which one non-regular block splits into two or more, each child is strictly below the parent in the chosen per-block ordinal. Splits are the only direction DM does not give for free.
findings.scope: Mechanism shape only. No per-block ordinal is defined, so no proof obligation is discharged.

findings.title: R2-02: two-sided coupled windows show no seed-orbit signature in Rule 30
findings.claim: A classifier on 5-column x 8-step two-sided windows can distinguish the single-seed Rule 30 orbit from orbits of random finite rows at held-out times.
findings.scope: Physical frame, columns -2..2, t in [64,4088), 20+20 disjoint random 33-cell rows, logistic and boosted trees, shuffled-label control; rules 30, 90, 150.
findings.result: Rule 30 held-out accuracy 0.499/0.492 (chance). Rule 150 positive control 0.996/0.999. Rule 90 degenerate (near-white).

findings.title: R2-02: the seed's column 1 is not more predictable from columns 0/1 than a generic orbit's
findings.claim: The seed's c1(t+1) is more predictable from c0[t-11..t+1], c1[t-11..t] than in generic orbits, indicating a seed-specific inheritance mechanism.
findings.scope: Target leakage excluded (c0(t+2) omitted). Train t in [76,2048), test [2048,4094); generic baseline from disjoint random orbits at matched training size 1972; rules 30, 90, 150.
findings.result: Rule 30 boosted accuracy 0.876 seed vs 0.895 generic: no seed-specific excess. Rule 150 seed 0.959 vs generic 0.514 (positive control). Rule 90 degenerate.

findings.title: R2-02: columns 0 and 1 cannot be jointly eventually periodic; Problem 1 reduces to column-1 inheritance
findings.claim: For Rule 30 from the single seed there are no T>=0, P>0 with columns 0 and 1 both P-periodic from T. Hence Problem 1 follows from: column 0 eventually periodic implies column 1 eventually periodic.
findings.scope: Exact seed, physical frame. Paper proof via left-permutivity, the light cone and the always-black left edge. Not kernel checked; likely already known.
findings.result: Paper proof in REPORT.md. The left-permutive identity checked exactly on the seed for 126 columns x 600 steps: 0 mismatches.
